pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries. Edges show moderately sharp pixel gradients with visible micro-crenulations or leaf-like indentations. Flank patches are more isometric, while neck patches are larger and more vertically elongated.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological mesh. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-valent or tetra-valent intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively consistent throughout the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged contour against the background. Individual bristle groups create a sharp, repetitive sawtooth profile.
